prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: review-only modular character anatomy/style board for Caelum Argenteum, issue #736 under #458. This is concept artwork, not evidence of a native 3D model.
Primary request: one clean landscape comparison board showing exactly six full-body standing adult figures of GOBLIN. Top row: same adult male in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Bottom row: same adult female in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Orthographic-like views, identical scale within each row, full heads and soles visible, relaxed neutral stance with arms slightly away from the torso. Believable anatomy and joints, ordinary capable physiques, no exaggerated superhero or childlike proportions.
Style and presentation: closely match reference image 1's polished restrained 3D character concept rendering, plain light gray studio background, soft neutral light, fine cloth/leather textures and clear consistent view layout. Image 1 is only the proposed human board for shared clothing/material/lighting/layout; it must not erase the species anatomy in the other references.
Clothing: male and female wear the same practical plain ivory/cream long-sleeved lace-collar shirt, loose dark charcoal trousers, simple brown leather belt, separate brown leather gloves and calf boots as image 1. Fully covering, modest fit. Each garment must read as a separate removable layer; hair, if applicable, is not built into the shirt. No armor, cape, scarf, jewelry, weapons, shields, new accessories or environment. No numeric heights or gameplay claims.
Species requirements: Reference image 2 is the owned male goblin head: preserve its angular humanoid face, prominent pointed ears extending sideways, natural tan/brown skin and short tousled dark hair. Reference image 3 is the owned four-female-face modular atlas: use its first-row female identity and ear silhouette; the bald scalp is a construction reference, not a proposed extra hairstyle. Add a simple separate short straight brown hairstyle with readable ear tips to the female. Both are adult humanoid goblins, naturally proportioned; no green skin, huge noses, tusks, horns or caricature. Preserve distinct male/female silhouettes without sexualized exaggeration. All three heads in each row must be the same individual.
Layout and exact text: title "GOBLIN / STYLE PROPOSAL"; subtitle "Concept only - pending author review"; row labels "MALE" and "FEMALE"; each row's column labels "FRONT", "PROFILE", "BACK". No other text. Generous spacing, crisp detail, no clipped body parts. Preserve each individual, clothing, color, head shape and hairstyle across its three views.
